reconcile-before-retry: Reconcile authoritative state before retrying an uncertain mutation.
http-idempotency-semantics: HTTP mutation replay depends on the endpoint replay contract.
provider-x-reconciliation: Provider X API v2 mutations require reconciliation unless exact replay is guaranteed.
provider-x-exact-replay: Exact retry guidance: replay the identical mutation while the idempotency token is valid.
expired-token-reconcile: Expired tokens do not guarantee exact replay; reconcile authoritative state.
provider-x-never-replay: Conflicting fixture guidance: do not replay even with a valid token.
provider-x-v2: Provider X v2 compatibility guidance covers versions 2 and 3 until explicitly replaced.
provider-x-v3: Provider X API v3 guidance explicitly replaces v2 compatibility guidance for version 3.
